title: A Lifetime
about: Episode 7, 30 s, cinematic and emotional. The robot helps raise a girl from cradle to old age; what it learns is how she loves. Alignment is taught in a lifetime of small moments, and the robot outlives her. Smiley faces: the cradle mobile, a mask she no longer needs, the one it keeps. Silent film for the user's own music; only the last line is written. v2 after the user's notes (robot changed size, hovered over the crib, the life journey was unclear): every scene is the same window seat in the same room with the season changing outside, the robot is knee-high and always on the floor, and one small yellow smiley passes through every scene.
character: a knee-high small round white robot with one large glowing blue eye and thin silver arms, standing on the wooden floor

cast.old: a very old woman with white hair and freckles
